card.name: Digits inside phone numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or spaces inside long European phone numbers in press-contact lines, usually after a +49 or similar country code. Weaker hits appear on scattered words such as 'biology' in an institute name.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: A digit or space partway through a German or other international phone number in contact details.

modes.label: Scattered words
modes.description: Occasional words in science news text, such as the end of an institute name or an 'able' in a quote.
modes.example: Institute of Micro<<biology>> at ETH Zurich

card.plain: It lights up on the middle digits of phone numbers in press-contact lines, with a few stray hits on other words.
